name: GREENFIELD FIRST
statement: Design from current requirements; do not migrate legacy architecture by default.

name: RAW IMMUTABLE
statement: Preserved raw evidence is never rewritten compacted or automatically cleaned.

name: ATOMIC TRUTH
statement: Atomic stores canonical traceable and reconstructible facts.

name: BUSINESS READ MODELS
statement: Business products optimize known questions without replacing atomic truth.

name: CURRENT STATE MODELS
statement: Current represents authorized present operational state, not event history or technical snapshots.

name: SECURITY BEFORE RETRIEVAL
statement: Apply identity permissions and scope before reading data.

name: SQL CALCULATES / LLM INTERPRETS AND EXPLAINS
statement: SQL and DuckDB calculate while the LLM interprets intent and explains results.

name: TRACEABILITY TO SOURCE
statement: Results must trace to source datasets rows and evidence.

name: METRICS ARE VERSIONED
statement: Metric definitions change only through explicit semantic versions.

name: PERFORMANCE IS PART OF THE CONTRACT
statement: Data-query latency is a measurable architecture requirement.

name: BUSINESS-AS-OF != TECHNICAL SNAPSHOT
statement: Business historical state is not inferred automatically from a lakehouse version.

name: DEV AND PROD USE IDENTICAL LOGICAL NAMES
statement: Environment isolation uses infrastructure rather than logical-name suffixes.

name: LEGACY IS EVIDENCE NOT ARCHITECTURE
statement: Legacy informs semantics cases and performance but does not define the new runtime.

name: DERIVED DATA MUST BE REBUILDABLE
statement: Derived products rebuild from preserved inputs manifests and versions.

name: NO BUSINESS SEMANTIC GUESSING
statement: Unknown business semantics remain explicit until evidence resolves them.

name: PREFER CONTENT EVOLUTION OVER SCHEMA EVOLUTION
statement: Stable concepts use canonical keys and relationships while changing taxonomies evolve as reference content.

name: VERSIONED RELATIONSHIPS
statement: Changing classifications and relationships preserve validity status source and confidence without fictitious dates.

name: NO GENERIC EAV BY DEFAULT
statement: Extensibility does not replace stable semantic concepts with generic attribute-name and attribute-value pairs.
